verdict.rationale: dlt offers some automated rule-like behaviors — schema/data contracts and schema evolution that automatically react to schema changes (dlt-docs-4, dlt-docs-20, dlt-docs-54), and incremental loading with merge_key/primary_key rules that automatically dedupe/upsert data (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-27) — but there is no evidence of a general-purpose event-trigger/rule engine where a user defines arbitrary 'on event X, do action Y' automations. Orchestration features (schedule, backfill, chain pipelines) are time/run-based rather than event-driven rule definitions (dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70). Missing for 10: explicit event-listener/trigger API, user-defined conditional rule syntax, examples of arbitrary action-on-event automation beyond schema/incremental handling.
